description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation” shows how the dataset is divided among different source categories, with six slices in total. The slices are labeled ENTITYQUEST (blue) at about 26.0%, HOTPOTQA (red) at about 24.2%, TRIVIAQA (orange) at about 22.7%, POPQA (yellow) at about 21.6%, TREC (green) at about 1.9%, and a small teal slice labeled 3.6% (the label text itself is not visible in the image). Labels and percentages are displayed outside the pie with leader lines pointing to each slice, there is no separate legend, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the largest slices appear to be the blue and red segments, with two very small segments (green and teal).
